text:
Before I touch anything: should "clean up" mean **organize** (sort files into subfolders by type, nothing deleted) or also **delete** (old installers, duplicates, junk)?

Until you answer, I'll only run a read-only scan of the 1,900 files and report what's taking up the 38 GB: largest files, duplicates, installers, and old zips. I'll leave anything modified in the last week alone, and I'll show you any deletion list for approval before removing a single file.
